items: 【Accessories】 Comes with a Microsoft Office 365 subscription that includes essential apps like Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and OneNote, along with cloud storage via OneDrive to enhance productivity. Also includes a WOWPC Recovery USB drive for easy system recovery and diagnostics when needed.

【Processor】 Runs on the Intel Celeron N4500 processor with 2 cores and 2 threads, reaching speeds up to 2.8GHz. Designed for efficiency, it offers dependable performance for everyday computing such as browsing, assignments, and media streaming. Integrated Intel UHD Graphics ensure fluid visuals, making it a solid choice for budget-conscious users and students.

【Operating System】 Preloaded with Windows 11 Pro 64-bit, providing robust security tools, productivity enhancements, and business-friendly management features. Perfect for both school and work, the OS delivers a user-friendly interface and excellent support for collaboration and modern applications.

【Key Features】 Features comprehensive connectivity with Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.3, USB-C, dual USB 3.2 ports, HDMI output, Ethernet port, and SD card reader. A full-size keyboard with numeric keypad ensures typing comfort, while the HD webcam with temporal noise reduction enhances video clarity. Fast charging support allows up to 50% charge in 45 minutes, maintaining battery health.

【Display】 Boasts a 15.6-inch Full HD (1920 x 1080) IPS anti-glare screen that delivers sharp, vibrant images and wide-angle viewing. Designed to reduce eye fatigue, it’s ideal for long hours of study, work, or streaming.
